mission.title: Revenge
mission.description: Protect a hardline repair operative while she fixes a junction box.

npc.say: Have you seen Fissure? She's due for extraction.

phase.briefing: Zion finally has the capability to find and repair the sabotaged junction boxes, thanks in no small part to your heroic efforts. We need you to rendezvous with one of our hardline repair operatives, escort her to a damaged junction box, and protect her while she repairs it. Zion is counting on you!

enter.say: Warrior, I've just received a signal from our junction box repair specialist, Fissure--she's under attack by Exiles in that building! She's managed to barricade herself behind a door, but there's no telling how long that will hold off her attackers. You have to locate her quickly and get her out of there!
You'll need to take care of these Exiles before Fissure will unlock the far door.

done.say: That was some impressive combat work, soldier. These Exiles are fools to continue trying to combat Zion.

talk.say: Oh, thank you! How could those Exiles have found me? Well never mind, let's go see that damaged junction box.

objective.text: Lead Fissure out of the building

phase.briefing: All right, I'm updating your waypoint with the damaged box's waypoint. Please see that Fissure gets there safely.

enter.say: The junction box is in that building.

objective.text: Bring Fissure to the junction box

done.say: Fissure has got the box fixed up. Please escort her out of there and... Uh-oh. Watch out, Warrior, I'm picking up multiple hostile programs converging on your position! Get Fissure out of there, now!
She's working like a champ now! Let's get out of here and to that extraction point.

objective.text: Lead Fissure out of the building

phase.briefing: I'm glad that you were able to get out of there safely, Warrior. Now, escort Fissure to the extraction point that I'm marking with a waypoint.

enter.say: The extraction point is in that building.

objective.text: Lead Fissure to the extraction team

done.say: Your job here is done, Warrior. Leave the extraction team to their work.
Thanks! You saved my bacon a couple times back there.

mission.finish: Well done, operative. It appears that both Exiles and imposter Agents are interested in our hardline repair operatives. We'll have to protect them more carefully in the future.
